message:
fix(apk): after a failed codec create, frames and the timer share one retry budget -- no delta tries before the deadline, terminal stops every path (keepalive-r2 e, Codex apk-decoder-liveness src r4 N3)

Codex reproduced on 0a108b3: an answered selection, its IDR's create failing, then 40 deltas 50 ms apart -- 41
creates in 2 s, codecRetries=0: ProcessFrame called EnsureCodecLocked for every frame and each failure pushed
the timer, so the budget, the cadence and the terminal state were all bypassed.

Now every create attempt goes through EnsureCodecLocked's one gate: after a failure each try -- a frame's or the
worker's timer -- is counted against the same budget (kCodecAutoRetryMax 20), and past it nobody tries
(codecTerminal_) until a new surface / selection / binding / stream reset. Before the 1 s deadline only an IDR
may try (its recovery stays immediate, as android_decoder_owed_key_test section 2 requires); a delta and the
timer wait. A codec made by any retry re-arms the owed IDR (one new token, the same bounded asks). Idle U5 / U5b
unchanged.

Comments corrected (Codex src r4 wording): 30 Mbit/s does not bound a single IDR below 4 MiB; 20 MB is a logical
payload budget, not the process's memory; which control changes ask for a codec reset (Prepare / Abort / stream
reset / binding) and why OnAck / BeginLocal / Refuse need not (no reservation can exist while awaiting) -- the
stale-commit void is the defence; the quiescent destructor does call the codec inline.

Tests: android_decoder_liveness_test 68/68 with [14] (Codex's schedule: <= 3 creates in the first 2 s, terminal
after exactly 21, no try while terminal even with IDRs, a new surface starts over; [7] now waits for the retry);
the 0a108b3 sink: 3 FAIL (41 creates in 2 s, 340 and never terminal). idr_recovery 49/49 (U5 +107 ms, U5b),
owed_key 32, pending_slot 21, prelogin 60, binding 17, decode_stats 42, geometry 10, session 9. NDK
buildCMakeDebug 4 ABIs OK; no APK.
